dataset_name: AssureX Claim Engine Common Warranty Dataset

scenarios.description: Covered fault, active warranty, valid receipt, matched serial and complete evidence.
Covered fault close to expiry but submitted before the expiry boundary.
Covered fault after an authorized repair that does not breach the replacement threshold.
Covered fault under an extended warranty with valid documents.
Covered fault with a longer repair history and supporting diagnostic evidence.
Fault and claim occur after the configured warranty expiry date.
Fault matches a policy exclusion such as physical, liquid, surge or unauthorized damage.
Repair was performed outside an authorized service center.
A receipt is present but invalid and purchase information is inconsistent.
The claim was reported after the category reporting period.
Replacement is requested before the policy repair threshold is reached.
One or more category-specific mandatory documents are absent.
The receipt serial number conflicts with the product serial number.
Two records share a product, invoice, serial and claim facts in one duplicate group.
Dates, serial numbers or model evidence contain a deterministic conflict.
Claim is submitted on the warranty expiry boundary and requires review.
Service-center authorization is unclear without confirmed unauthorized repair.

notes: The dataset is generated locally; no external dataset is used.
The same records are rendered to CSV and Claim Summary Cards.
Duplicate groups are kept inside one data split.
Audit and rule outputs are excluded from model inputs.
